name: ZCanopy broker API - endpoints added to the broker web controller
description: The broker endpoints that were added to the web dashboard controller (web/broker/*) and mirrored into the mobile app controller (brokers/*). Every endpoint needs the broker bearer token; the broker code is taken from the token, so it is never sent in the body.

auth.note: The token carries the broker identity (brokerCode). The gateway reads it from the token and injects it into the service call.

endpoints.summary: Submit landlord identity and property title details for the UgNLIS title search

landlord.fullName.description: Landlord full name (also accepted as the top-level fullName)

landlord.nin.description: Landlord national ID number (also accepted as nin)

landlord.phoneNumber.description: Landlord phone number (also accepted as phoneNumber)

search.mzoDistrict.description: MZO district where the land sits (also accepted as mzoDistrict)

search.tenureType.description: Tenure type, e.g. Freehold / Mailo / Leasehold (also accepted as tenureType)

search.location.leaseExpiryDate.description: Lease expiry date (also accepted as leaseExpiryDate)

search.location.subCountyVillage.description: Sub county / village (also accepted as subCountyVillage)

search.location.ccoRefNumber.description: CCO reference number (also accepted as ccoRefNumber)

brokerConfirmations.description: Broker codes that confirmed the same landlord

endpoints.notes: When the landlord is already registered to another broker the response asks for a landlord authorisation instead of approving silently.

endpoints.summary: Send confirmation OTPs to the other brokers linked to the same landlord
Send an authorisation OTP to a landlord who is already verified for another broker

verificationId.description: The verification returned by the landlord-details submission

endpoints.notes: The OTP goes to the landlord's own phone number, so it doubles as their consent.

endpoints.summary: Confirm the landlord authorisation OTP and the landlord NIN for the requesting broker

verificationId.description: The verification the OTP was sent for

landlordNin.description: The landlord's NIN, used to prove it is the same person (also accepted as brokerNin)

endpoints.notes: On success the landlord is approved for this broker too and the instrument number is returned.

endpoints.summary: Get the landlord & title verification status of the authenticated broker
endpoints.response: { status, instrumentNumber, rejectionReason, submittedAt, verificationId, needsLandlordAuthorization, landlordPhoneMasked, landlord: { fullName, nin, mzoDistrict, tenureType } }
endpoints.notes: status is one of unsubmitted | pending | approved | rejected.

endpoints.summary: Get the broker's own verification status and uploaded documents
endpoints.notes: verificationStatus is one of unsubmitted | pending | approved.

endpoints.summary: Submit the broker's ID documents for verification

idFrontUrl.description: URL of the uploaded front ID image

idBackUrl.description: URL of the uploaded back ID image

endpoints.summary: List the bookings of the authenticated broker
Approve or reject a booking

status.description: The new status, e.g. Approved or Rejected

endpoints.summary: Get the wallet of the authenticated broker
Get the wallet transactions of the authenticated broker
Withdraw wallet funds to mobile money (needs the landlord OTP)

phoneNumber.description: Mobile money number that receives the money

payeeName.description: Name on the mobile money account

otp.description: The OTP that was sent to the landlord

endpoints.summary: Request the authorisation OTP that is sent to the landlord for a withdrawal
endpoints.notes: The OTP is emailed to the landlord, not to the broker, so only the landlord can authorise the payout.

endpoints.summary: Get the messages of the authenticated broker
Get the profile of the authenticated broker
endpoints.response: { broker: { id, username, email, phoneNumber, brokerCode, location, isVerified, subscriptionTier, ... } }

endpoints.summary: Update the profile of the authenticated broker

brokerBrandName.description: New brand name shown on listings

endpoints.summary: Change the broker password (requires the OTP sent to the broker's email)

emailOtp.description: The OTP that was emailed to the broker

endpoints.summary: Request the OTP that authorises a password change
Send a help request to the support team
Delete the broker account (requires the OTP sent to the broker's email)

emailOtp.description: The OTP that was emailed to the broker

endpoints.summary: Request the OTP that confirms an account deletion
Log the broker out
